name: Credit ratings

subjectOf.text: Because contingent capital is a hybrid instrument that pays fixed returns while bearing equity like risk, it may receive low or no ratings, attract a much smaller investor base, and carry higher funding costs.
subjectOf.abstract: As a hybrid security, contingent capital may receive low or no ratings and may have a much smaller investor base and higher costs of funding.
subjectOf.citation: Wulf A. Kaal, Christoph Henkel, Contingent Capital with Sequential Triggers (2011). SSRN: https://ssrn.com/abstract=1908473
scope_conditions: Holds while rating methodologies for hybrid contingent instruments remain unsettled

subjectOf.text: Because LER voucher redemptions generate revenue at fiat parity, they can improve issuer credit ratings and lower borrowing costs, with large issuers projected to save up to $440 million annually through debt refinancing.
subjectOf.abstract: Because LER voucher reward redemptions generate revenue at fiat parity, LER enhance throughput and potentially improve LER issuers' credit ratings and lower borrowing costs. Large LER issuers are projected to save up to $440 million annually through debt refinancing.
subjectOf.citation: Wulf A. Kaal, Liquid Equity Rewards (2025). SSRN: https://ssrn.com/abstract=5454054
scope_conditions: redemptions recognized as revenue at fiat parity

subjectOf.text: For large issuers, the favorable accounting treatment and fiat-parity redemption revenue could improve credit ratings enough to save as much as $440 million a year in interest through debt refinancing.
subjectOf.abstract: For large firms, the favorable accounting treatment could result in annual savings of up to $440 million through debt refinancing, as enhanced credit ratings lower interest expenses.
subjectOf.citation: Wulf A. Kaal, Liquid Equity Rewards in Corporate America (2025). SSRN: https://ssrn.com/abstract=5583610
scope_conditions: large issuers with substantial loyalty programs and $25 to $40 billion debt loads
credit rating improvement of one to two notches
